cohort: 299 patients who underwent modified LTCC from 2003 to 2018
finding: Modified LTCC appears to be a safe and feasible surgical option during pregnancy for patients with a history of RPL due to cervical factors.
mod_finding: 176 successful deliveries were via cesarean section.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at surgery: 12.5 weeks (range 10.5-17.5 weeks)
